# Global Setup and Configuration

Spatio-temporal disease mapping model (NYC & Utah):
$$Y_{g,t} \sim \text{NegBin}(\mu_{g,t}, \theta)$$
$$\log(\mu_{g,t}) = \log(E_g) + \log(\mu_0(t)) + \log(\rho(g,t)) + \mathbf{x}_{g,t}^\top\boldsymbol{\beta} + b_g + \gamma_t$$

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("helpers/_utils.R"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

# Configuration

```{r config}
CONFIG <- list(

  # ---- Directories ----
  data_dir     = "data",
  advan_dir    = file.path("data", "advan_weekly_plus"),
  output_dir   = file.path("outputs", "spatiotemporal_risk"),
  grids_dir    = file.path("outputs", "spatiotemporal_risk", "grids"),
  figures_dir  = file.path("outputs", "spatiotemporal_risk", "figures"),
  cache_dir    = file.path("outputs", "spatiotemporal_risk", "cache"),

  # ---- Boundaries ----
  ny_cbg_path  = file.path("data", "cbg_shapefiles", "newyork_shp", "tl_2024_36_bg.shp"),
  ut_cbg_path  = file.path("data", "cbg_shapefiles", "utah_shp", "tl_2024_49_bg.shp"),
  ut_counties_path = file.path("data", "ut_counties", "CensusCounties2010.shp"),

  # ---- COVID Cases ----
  covid_dir          = file.path("data", "us_CovidCases"),
  nyc_caserate_path  = file.path("data", "us_CovidCases", "caseRate", "NYCcaserate-by-modzcta.csv"),
  nyc_crosswalk_path = file.path("data", "us_CovidCases", "caseRate", "NYCcbg_to_modzcta.csv"),
  nyc_modzcta_shp    = file.path("data", "MODZCTA",
                                  "geo_export_5392c927-ee1e-4b9c-9787-2cad9456c83b.shp"),

  # ---- Utah (all 29 counties) ----
  ut_state_fips = "49",
  ut_fips_5 = c("49001", "49003", "49005", "49007", "49009", "49011",
                "49013", "49015", "49017", "49019", "49021", "49023",
                "49025", "49027", "49029", "49031", "49033", "49035",
                "49037", "49039", "49041", "49043", "49045", "49047",

                "025", "027", "029", "031", "033", "035",
                "037", "039", "041", "043", "045", "047",

  bridge_csv          = file.path("data", "transport", "Bridge_Ratings_20260213.csv"),
  subway_stations_csv = file.path("data", "transport", "MTA_Subway_Stations_20260217.csv"),
  subway_routes_shp   = file.path("data", "transport", "nyu_subway", "routes_nyc_subway_may2016.shp"),

  # ---- Waves (continuous 3-month fitting periods) ----
  waves = list(
    wave1 = list(id = "wave1", months = c("2020-03", "2020-04", "2020-05"),
                 label = "Wave 1: Initial Outbreak (Mar–May 2020)",
                 acs_year = "2020"),
    wave2 = list(id = "wave2", months = c("2020-12", "2021-01", "2021-02"),
                 label = "Wave 2: Winter Surge (Dec 2020–Feb 2021)",
                 acs_year = "2021"),
    wave3 = list(id = "wave3", months = c("2021-12", "2022-01", "2022-02"),
                 label = "Wave 3: Omicron (Dec 2021–Feb 2022)",
                 acs_year = "2022")
  ),
  wave_ids = c("wave1", "wave2", "wave3"),

  # ---- Model Parameters ----
  spillover_phi   = 10000,
  origin_lag      = 7,
  spillover_alpha = 0.7,
  bym_phi_prior   = c(0.5, 0.5),
  bym_prec_prior  = c(1, 0.01),

  states = c("NY", "UT")
)

# Create directories (wave-native: only one output dir per (state, wave))
local({
  for (d in c(CONFIG$output_dir, CONFIG$grids_dir, CONFIG$figures_dir, CONFIG$cache_dir)) {
    dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  }
  for (state in CONFIG$states) {
    for (wid in CONFIG$wave_ids) {
      wave_dir <- file.path(CONFIG$output_dir, paste0(state, "_", wid))
      for (sub in c("models", "tables", "intermediate", "figures", "network")) {
        dir.create(file.path(wave_dir, sub), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
      }
    }
  }
})
```

# Batch Runs

```{r batch}
WAVE_RUNS <- rbindlist(lapply(CONFIG$states, function(s) {
  rbindlist(lapply(CONFIG$waves, function(w) {
    data.table(state = s, wave_id = w$id, wave_label = w$label,
               wave_months = list(w$months),
               acs_year = w$acs_year)
  }))
}))
WAVE_RUNS[, run_id  := paste0(state, "_", wave_id)]
WAVE_RUNS[, out_dir := file.path(CONFIG$output_dir, run_id)]
print(WAVE_RUNS)
```

# Save

```{r save}
# State-specific configs for safety; shared CONFIG.rds for downstream compatibility
saveRDS(CONFIG, file.path(CONFIG$output_dir, "CONFIG.rds"))
local({
  for (s in CONFIG$states) {
    saveRDS(CONFIG, file.path(CONFIG$output_dir, sprintf("CONFIG_%s.rds", s)))
  }
})
saveRDS(WAVE_RUNS, file.path(CONFIG$output_dir, "WAVE_RUNS.rds"))
```
